headline: Premier League Friday: Ipswich host Forest to open Matchweek 8
whyCareReason: Matchweek 8 begins Friday at Portman Road. Forest sit 19th on 5 points, Ipswich 12th on 8.
teaser: Friday 23 October, 20:00 UK, Portman Road. City lead table on 21; Chelsea host Spurs on Saturday.
story: Matchweek 8 of the Premier League kicks off on Friday, 23 October, at Portman Road as Ipswich Town host Nottingham Forest at 20:00 UK. Ipswich enter in 12th place with 8 points from seven matches (2-2-3), having pushed leaders Manchester City in a 3-2 defeat last weekend. Forest sit 19th in the relegation zone on 5 points (1-2-4) following a narrow 1-0 home loss to Arsenal. Manchester City lead the table with a perfect 21 points, three ahead of Arsenal on 18. Saturday's slate is headlined by the Chelsea versus Tottenham derby at Stamford Bridge.
stakes: Forest seek to climb out of the bottom three while Ipswich aim to solidify their mid-table position.
rivalryAngle: Friday night football under the Portman Road lights opens Matchweek 8.
